acquisition_request_if_deficit_confirmed.bound: Download only the three listed exact files after any necessary acquisition approval; no expansion to other corpus files under this proposal.
acquisition_request_if_deficit_confirmed.minimum_claim: This is the smallest package within the three named candidate communities that supplies all three pair labels without using an old community. It is not a proven globally minimal or sufficient data acquisition.

dataset_documentation.provider_description: ConvoKit describes per-subreddit corpora built from Pushshift posts/comments, from each community inception through October 2018. This provider scope statement is not a fresh verification of any proposed archive.

design_implications: These three pair labels can supply three candidate strata without using Cornell, ApplyingToCollege or college as a stratum member.
Different community names do not establish independent samples or distinct verified topics. All three remain academic communities; this is not broad nonacademic coverage.
Accounts must be allocated to one block and one stratum across all three candidate pairs. An account writing in all three communities cannot be counted in multiple strata.
The protected/scored/private exclusions, common periods, four cells per account, 2000 eligible whole-record words and at least eight eligible records per cell must remain unchanged.
A score-free joint capacity census must show whether disjoint cohorts and viable periods exist. Listed archive sizes cannot establish feasible20account strata.

Current community descriptions and cross-references are only a plausibility argument for inspection; they do not establish historical2018 content, participant overlap, language or eligible writing volume.

If these are approved for acquisition, record fresh archive hashes and actual source record counts, metadata completeness and local-use permissions before choosing dates/cohorts. Do not skip Gate A or Gate B.
permissions_and_limits: Official availability and existing project provenance do not establish a corpus-specific redistribution license. Keep any later raw acquisition private pending its documented permissions.
No HEAD request to archive URLs and no ZIP content read was performed; sizes are the official directory-listed byte counts only.
Directory modification times are recorded as printed; timezone is unspecified and they are not observation dates.
The local corpus deficit must be reported separately with actual census counts; this proposal does not presume that deficit or authorize quietly shrinking the study.

possible_new_community_pair_strata.subject_relationship: Academic careers/institutions and graduate-student experiences; related academic settings with potentially different discussion purposes.
General academic questions and doctoral-degree experiences; related audiences but a broader versus degree-specific discussion scope.
Graduate-student issues and doctoral-degree experiences; substantial conceptual overlap, with PhD narrower than all graduate study.

purpose: Bounded possible follow-on archive request, contingent on observed Gate A deficit. No corpus archives downloaded, no record content collected, no source-account overlap asserted.
scope: Only AskAcademia, GradSchool and PhD archive entries were retained from their official directory indexes. Parent index navigation and the three current community about/rule pages supplied metadata and descriptive context.

sources.current_scope_paraphrase: Questions about academia across career stages, disciplines and institutions. Current rules redirect complaints about graduate school to GradSchool.
sources.rationale: The explicit current connection to graduate-school discussion makes shared participant accounts plausible; it does not establish overlap in the archived period.

sources.current_scope_paraphrase: Graduate-student discussion; current rules address graduate-student issues and direct program admissions comparisons elsewhere.
sources.rationale: Graduate students may also ask academic-career questions and discuss doctoral experiences. Shared accounts and sufficient repeated writing across years remain unmeasured.

sources.current_scope_paraphrase: A community for doctoral students and holders centered on the PhD experience; current rules redirect questions about the value of a PhD to AskAcademia.
sources.rationale: The explicitly overlapping academic/doctoral audience is a reason to inspect metadata if acquisition is approved. The archive is much smaller than the other two, so capacity is especially uncertain.
